purpose: Unresolved symlink artifacts (ctx.actions.declare_symlink, StarlarkActionFactory.declareSymlink :194-225, --allow_unresolved_symlinks default true, CoreOptions.java:878-893) in analysis and execution: ctx.actions.symlink(output, target_path = ..., target_type = None|"file"|"directory") registers an UnresolvedSymlinkAction (analysis/starlark/UnresolvedSymlinkAction.java: mnemonic UnresolvedSymlink, keyed by GUID, the literal target and the target type, no inputs; execute creates the symlink with PathFragment.create(target)); a spawn may create a declared symlink too (ActionOutputMetadataStore.fileArtifactValueFromArtifact reads it with readlink; anything else is `declared output 'P' is not a symlink`, SkyframeActionExecutor.checkOutputs); the artifact's value is its link text (FileArtifactValue.UnresolvedSymlinkArtifactValue: SHA-256 of the text with the first byte inverted); consumers stage it as a symlink with that text (SandboxHelpers.processInputFiles; unsandboxed the execution root holds it), runfiles trees create it textually (SymlinkTreeHelper.createRunfilesSymlinks) and the runfiles manifest names the text (SourceManifestAction.writeFile :301-312). Motivation: ~/code `build //src/beyondwork.ai/tools/...` (rules_python venvs: `_build_tar.venv/bin/python3 -> ../../../../../../rules_python++python+python_3_12_x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/python3`) and the aspect_rules_js node_modules links of `build //src/ts/...` stopped at the native explicit gap `creating the unresolved symlink artifact ... is not implemented in the native profile`.

reference.environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME/TMPDIR private LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8; one fresh copy of the fixture workspace per case (the genuine platforms 1.0.0 module extracted into `platforms` from tests/fixtures/label_repo_name/platforms_archive.json)

normalization: <WS> = the case's workspace copy; <OB> = the genuine output base; <CACHE> = the native cache; elapsed times <T>. Outputs are the top-level outputs (genuine --show_result lines, bazel-bin = bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin; native LABEL<TAB>PATH lines below the action output root) as [mode, contents]; an unresolved symlink output as ["symlink", link text].
comparison (tests/unresolved_symlinks.rs: MATCH: success equal; WARNING lines equal in order; a failing case's genuine message (or the recorded part of it) (the `Error in <callable>: ` / `Error: ` Starlark text, else the rule error following an empty `in KIND rule L: ` line, else the first ERROR message) is contained in native stderr; built top-level outputs (path below bazel-out -> [mode, contents]) equal; a `test` case's stdout (the test summary, ` in N.Ns` run times as ` in <T>s`) equal; a successful `run` case's stdout (the program's output) equal; a `query` case's stdout equal; the recorded outputs' existence after the command equal. DECLARED_DIVERGENCE: native fails with the recorded message.
genuine_key_findings: A declared symlink File: is_symlink True, is_directory False, is_source False, basename/extension/dirname/short_path/root like a declared file (bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin), the owner the declaring target; nested paths (node_modules/.store/pkg@1/node_modules/pkg) and `sibling` (next to probe.base) work; a declared file has is_symlink False; equality and depset deduplication treat it as one value.
`--nobuild` analyzes symlink producers, consumers (run_shell inputs) and a binary with symlinks in its runfiles without building them; `build` of the probe builds only its text file.

Errors: `symlink() with "target_file" param requires that "output" be declared as a file or directory, not a symlink (...)`, `symlink() with "target_path" param requires that "output" be declared as a symlink, not a file or directory (...)`, `"is_executable" cannot be True when using "target_path"`, `"target_type" must be one of "file" or "directory"`, `Exactly one of "target_file" or "target_path" is required`, `in call to symlink(), parameter 'target_path' got value of type 'int', want 'string or NoneType'`; a declared symlink without an action, and a file and a symlink declared at one path (either order), are `The following files have no generating action:` (the second declaration is a different artifact, never `already been declared as something other than a symlink`).

Execution: the output is a symlink with the literal target (relative `data.txt`, `../does/not/exist` dangling at creation, `../../../../data.txt`, a spawn's `ln -s data.txt`); a consumer's run_shell `readlink` of its inputs prints those targets, sandboxed and with --spawn_strategy=standalone; a link resolving in the execution root (`../../../../external/pyrt+/lib/marker.txt`) reads its target there; `run` of a binary lists the symlinks of its runfiles tree (./pkg/node_modules/.store/pkg@1/node_modules/pkg, ./pkg/rel, ./pkg/show).

A rules_python-like venv (`_venv_tool.venv/bin/python3 -> ../../../../pyrt+/bin/python3` into an external repository, next to a declared pyvenv.cfg): `run`, a spawn using it as a tool (sandboxed and standalone) and a test find the venv through argv[0] and the installation through realpath(argv[0]); the runfiles manifest line is `_main/venv/_venv_tool.venv/bin/python3 ../../../../pyrt+/bin/python3` (the link text).
A spawn that leaves a regular file at a declared symlink's path fails: `declared output 'venv/not_a_symlink' is not a symlink`.
known_divergences: Native prints its own result format (`LABEL\tPATH`, `bazel-rs: N actions executed ...`), no INFO lines.

dir(File) natively lacks `tree_relative_path` (pre-existing; genuine: [basename, dirname, extension, is_directory, is_source, is_symlink, owner, path, root, short_path, tree_relative_path]); `--[no]allow_unresolved_symlinks` is not a modelled option (its default true is the native behavior).
Native is passed --experimental-builtin-modules in every case (as in the other paired fixtures).
